drops enum-variant struct-literal instantiates whose target is the variant leaf (MatchStrategy::Suffix -> Suffix): the pre-fix analyzer required a plain type_identifier and silently dropped scoped names
targets turbofish calls (x.parse::<u32>()) by whole base text instead of the callee leaf: restores the pre-fix bug where generic_function used baseNode.text
re-emits calls edges for parenthesized closure callees ((self.0)(n)): the pre-fix else branch took functionNode.text verbatim and fabricated a (self.0) target
drops union_item declaration sites (Pixel): the pre-fix analyzer had no union_item branch, so Rust unions emitted NO symbol
drops trait-level associated_type symbols (Container.Item): the pre-fix analyzer only handled impl-level type_item, so trait bodies' `type Item;` were invisible

re-emits the raw await edge in ADDITION to the canonical call edge (the pre-fix await_expression branch pushed a second calls edge with the full function text as target): one awaited call site must produce exactly ONE calls edge

stores the whole use-declaration raw text as the import module (pre-fix: `use std::io::{Read, Write as W}` became module='std::io::{Read, Write as W}' with comma-split items): restores the family-contract violation
targets package-qualified stdlib calls by whole text instead of the leaf (fmt.Sprintf -> fmt.Sprintf target): restores the pre-fix buildGoCallExpression behavior the oracle flagged
drops package-scope call edges (go_package_scope_call): the pre-fix analyzer never emitted NewShape() at package level
re-emits calls edges for anonymous func-literal goroutine/defer bodies (target 'anonymous_closure'): restores the pre-fix extractGoRoutineFunction/extractDeferredFunction behavior
emits calls edges for builtin type-conversion expressions (float64(...)): the pre-fix oracle-mismatch class where bare builtin calls leaked as call truth
drops implicit interface implements edges (go_interface_implementation): a regression that removes duck-typing satisfaction detection

drops implements edges that arise from EMBEDDED-STRUCT method promotion (Worker impl Runner via *Shape.Run, no own methods): the pre-promotion analyzer (and oracle) silently lost these, so a struct implementing an interface through an embedded type was missed

restores the pre-fix embedded-interface blind spot: emits FileBad->ReadCloser (a struct with ONLY Close()) as if it satisfied the embedding ReadCloser { Reader; Close() } — the false positive that existed because promoted Reader.Read was never folded into ReadCloser's method set
